model_annotation: This figure presents a comparison of enterprises, employment, and turnover across four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services, as percentages of the total economy in 2021. The figure consists of three pie charts, each representing one of these metrics. Each chart is divided into four segments, corresponding to the four sectors, and includes a legend at the bottom identifying the colors: red for industry, orange for construction, blue for trade, and gray for other services. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The "Number of Enterprises" chart shows segments representing 61% (19.0 mln) for industry, 19% (5.9 mln) for construction, 12% (3.7 mln) for trade, and 8% (2.4 mln) for other services. The "Number of Persons Employed" chart displays segments of 51% (80.2 mln) for industry, 19% (29.5 mln) for construction, 9% (13.4 mln) for trade, and 21% (33.0 mln) for other services. Finally, the "Turnover" chart shows segments of 33% (10.6 tln) for industry, 31% (9.8 tln) for construction, 31% (9.9 tln) for trade, and 6% (1.9 tln) for other services. The segments in each chart appear ordered in a descending visual size.
